result.summary: Found 1 issue: duplicate identical restaurant cards appearing consecutively in the Fastest near you section.

issues.description: The first two cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are identical: both show 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same image, same '15-25 min' badge and same '€0.90 delivery' text side by side.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel renders unique restaurants; remove the duplicate entry and fix the data source to prevent duplication.
